sources.title: TI SDYA009C, Designing With Logic
sources.locator: Sections 6.2 and 6.4; printed pages 14-15 and 18-19; Figure 21 and Table 3
sources.scope: Bipolar output undershoot can affect internal bias and later switching. The illustrated bus-driver clamp is not a supplied SN7406 subcircuit. Table 3 gives family-average capacitances, explicitly allows device variation, and labels the open-collector column for low-drive gates.

sources.title: TI SZZA008, Input and Output Characteristics of Digital Integrated Circuits at 5-V Supply Voltage
sources.scope: Describes protection-diode behavior for negative output peaks; the standard-TTL plotted example is SN7400, not SN7406.

interpretation: These sources support investigating output recovery and pin loading, but do not identify the SN7406 junction parameters or authorize importing a bus-driver clamp. A converged negative excursion is not independently validated device behavior.
nextAction: Isolate the retained negative-output excursion; examine internal transistor charge and collector-base current, then test only independently supported output-recovery or package-loading hypotheses. Preserve the existing candidate as the control.
